review_notes: Build an AST for top-level code following an indented block. Adding spaces between stored physical lines changes indentation and can make valid source invalid. Concatenate physical lines exactly, without injecting characters. Original F2P/P2P unchanged. Baseline diagnostic failure is expected task reproduction, not a policy error. Source imports asserted against the workspace before and after the repair.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/flake8/processor.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('flake8.processor')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from argparse import Namespace
from flake8.processor import FileProcessor
options=Namespace(hang_closing=False,indent_size=4,max_line_length=79,max_doc_length=None,verbose=0)
import ast
processor=FileProcessor('example.py',options,lines=['if True:\n','    pass\n','pass\n'])
tree=processor.build_ast()
print('ast_nodes',[type(n).__name__ for n in tree.body])
assert len(tree.body)==2 and isinstance(tree.body[0],ast.If) and isinstance(tree.body[1],ast.Pass)
assert tree.body[1].lineno==3 and tree.body[1].col_offset==0

PYREPLAY
